title: Advice machine transition rule
statement: For a machine with four states, no work tapes, and Boolean input and output symbols, define its transition as follows. In state $0$, on input $1$ it moves to state $1$, on input $0$ it moves to state $2$, and on a blank it halts emitting $0$. In state $1$, on either Boolean input it moves to state $0$, and on a blank it halts emitting $0$. In state $2$, on input $1$ it moves to state $3$, and on input $0$ or a blank it halts emitting $0$. In state $3$, on input $b$ it halts emitting $b$, and on a blank it halts emitting $0$. In every transition to another state, it uses the action denoted by the corresponding move.
